hypothesis: Test the quantum head inside a complete small hybrid cross-attention block, rather than assuming isolated-head gains transfer through residuals, normalization and an FFN.
architecture: 4-dimensional tokens [key0,key1,value,role], fixed identity value/output maps, attention+residual+fixed LayerNorm, trainable4x4 tanh FFN+residual+fixed LayerNorm, binary readout. Quantum4 parameters+temperature or classical2x2 metric+temperature; 50 trainable parameters per model.
design: 3 seeds,64 train/64 validation/256 test episodes; warm-start both heads from prior trained retrieval maps; shared classical initialization within seed. Joint exact-expectation L-BFGS-B up to60 iterations, checkpoint selected on validation loss. Evaluate ideal and finite-shot quantum attention.
limits: Warm-start transfer study, not from-scratch architecture comparison. Fixed projections/nontrainable normalization differ from standard Transformer. Classical optimizer steps do not equate wall-time or QPU training cost.
